observations.content: P95 latency for /api/v2/orders is 1200ms, exceeding the 500ms SLA target
Latency spike correlates with uncached database joins on the order_items table
Redis cache exists but only covers /api/v2/products with a 60s TTL
Cache hit rate on /products is 94%, but no caching on /orders or /users endpoints
Adding a composite index on (order_id, item_id, created_at) reduced order_items join time by 60% in staging
API returns raw 500 errors with stack traces in production for unhandled exceptions
No structured error response format — clients receive inconsistent error shapes across endpoints
No retry logic on upstream service calls; a single timeout from payment-service cascades as a user-facing 500
Circuit breaker pattern was proposed in RFC-0042 but never implemented
Current uptime is 99.1%, target is 99.9%; most downtime comes from cascading failures
OpenAPI spec is 6 months out of date; 12 endpoints added since last update
Three external teams have filed support tickets about undocumented breaking changes in v2.3
Python SDK covers only v2.0 endpoints; v2.1-v2.3 require raw HTTP calls
TypeScript SDK has 14 open issues, 3 of which are type definition mismatches with actual responses
Average time-to-first-successful-call for new API consumers is 4.5 hours, target is 30 minutes
